sources.title: US Census population and migration, vintage 2024

limitations: Cycle labels describe observed housing indicators; they do not predict land appreciation.
Population / migration vintage ends in 2024. Metro population is not inferred from counties.
Metro inventory, sales and days-to-pending coverage varies; state/county scans have price and demographic coverage only.
Revised current-vintage series are not point-in-time backtests.
Employment, permits, infrastructure, affordability and land-price evidence still require research.
Metro state filters include states named by the provider; metros can cross state boundaries.
